description:
What this is. When you hire someone, the clinic still needs to know who they are before they can be sent for a health check. This page has a small section for that: their ID number, phone number, date of birth and whether they are male or female. Most of it fills in by itself from the person's application.

A guided tour. Opening this step walks you through the page one box at a time and explains what each one is for. You can start it again whenever you like with the small i button at the top of the page.

Where to find it. Job Offer is found under HR › Recruitment. From the list you can sign up several people at once.
name: Fill the COVA Block on a Job Offer
title: Job Offer — details the clinic needs
